senses.gloss: (v. preced., cmp. יָרד) to run, discharge matter; to be sore, inflamed.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. II, 40ᵈ top <he>עין שמָרְדָה</he> an inflamed eye (comment.: ‘which rebels’, i.e. threatens to burst out of its socket).—Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 3, ch. IV <he>שחין המוֹרֵד ומכוה המוֹרֶדֶת</he> a running (open) wound from contusion or from a burn; <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 6:8">Neg. VI, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 8:5">VIII, 5</cite> <he>השחין המכוה והקדח המוֹרְדִין</he> (not <he>והמורדין</he>) running wounds from contusion, burn or inflammation; <cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 3:10">Tosef. ib. III, 10</cite> <he>השחין והמכוה והקרח והמירין</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>והמידק</he>, corr. acc.; v. R. S. to Neg. l. c.; R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 6:8">Neg. VI, 8</cite> quotes a Var. <he>מורר׳</he>, v. R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 9:2">Par. IX, 2</cite>; v. <cite ref="M00653"><he>מוֹרִיר</he></cite>). Sifra l. c., Par. 4, ch. VII <he>מורדת</he>; Y. Pes. VII, 34ᵃ bot. <he>מגרדת</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr.
